R_ENTAIL_HIGH_OVERLAP.description: Evidence sentence from verified TRUE claim with >= 2 matching content tokens and zero refutation cues.

R_ENTAIL_MODERATE_OVERLAP.description: Evidence sentence from verified TRUE claim with exactly 1 matching content token and zero refutation cues.

R_CONTRA_EXPLICIT_REFUTATION.description: Evidence sentence from verified FALSE claim containing explicit negation/refutation markers and >= 1 matching content token.

R_NEUTRAL_ARTICLE_CONTEXT.description: Contextual sentence from the same article of a TRUE claim with 0 content word overlap, providing setting or background without affirming the assertion.

R_NEUTRAL_FALSE_CONTEXT.description: Background sentence from a FALSE claim article with zero refutation cues and 0 content word overlap.

R_NEUTRAL_NEI_CONTEXT.description: Evidence sentence from an inconclusive (NEI) claim that provides non-definitive background and lacks refutation cues.
